title: [root] MAX11 loopless k=5 exact decision
description:
## Goal
Decide, exactly, whether MAX_11 lies in the span of the complete loopless degree-five signed-W atom universe (G-0027: 754,017 orbits) plus the 5E/5L carriers. A rational certificate settles the n=11 rung of "two hidden ReLU layers compute max of n numbers" (known n<=10, Rueß et al. arXiv:2607.21651). A negative is a bounded null with a rational separator, routing to enlargement (loops, non-braid generators, degree 6).
## Read first
handoff/2026-09-02-RESUME-SYNTHESIS.md §1 (object), §3 (verified facts), §7/§8a (plan), §10 (glossary). AGENTS.md "Swarm operations".
## Binding rules
See AGENTS.md. Only the orchestrator (AmberBluff) closes beads. Every result names its denominator and its no-claim boundary.

title: Rust column generator for loopless signed-W atoms (validated vs n=9/10 systems + G-0028 prices)
description:
## Context
Path 1 of handoff §7 / step 1 of §8a. A column is the S_n-symmetrised atom function restricted to the sorted cone {x_1<=...<=x_n}: a linear part l in Z^n plus a sparse hinge dictionary h: primitive direction d -> integer coefficient (rows = primitive zero-sum directions with mixed-sign prefix sums, oriented first-nonzero-positive). Two existing implementations disagree only by convention:
- Python `handoff/2026-09-02-amberbluff/probes/loopless_probe_par.py::column_dp` (simple loop-free pairs (A,B); rows d = other-base over sorted joint prefix vectors; nonpositive-on-cone rows dropped; gcd-normalised). Saved outputs: `handoff/2026-09-02-amberbluff/systems/loopless_system_n9.jsonl.gz` (10,976 templates) and `_n10.jsonl.gz` (12,248); one JSON line per template with A,B,linear,hinges.
- Rust `artifacts/math/G-0028/src/main.rs`: for a signed-W record (W=B-A multigraph), w_r(pi)=sum_{t<r} W[v_r,v_t], orientation first-nonzero-positive, ReLU(-z)=ReLU(z)-z folded into the linear part, 10*r*9! base term; it PRICES against a dual and does not emit columns. Universe file: `artifacts/math/G-0027/loopless_signed_degree5_universe_v1.json.gz` (754,017 records; schema in G-0028 README and LOOP_INCLUSIVE_SIGNED_W_SCHEMA.md). Carriers 5E/5L: G-0040 README.
## Outcome
`tools/colgen/` Rust crate: for any loopless signed-W record and any n, emit the full sparse column (l, h) exactly over Z (checked arithmetic) and mod p, streaming (JSONL or compact binary), multi-threaded, designed so loop records can be added later. Also emit, over the whole n=11 universe, the count of distinct retained hinge directions (union of supports) and total nnz.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Positive 1: for every n=9 and n=10 saved template (mapped to W=B-A) the Rust column equals the saved Python column after a documented convention map; report matches/total. Any residual disagreement must be explained by an exact identity and reconciled, not waved through.
- [ ] Positive 2: dual·column over the G-0028 registered records reproduces the frozen G-0028 per-record prices at both primes (or a stated large random sample of the 754,017 scan if per-record prices are stored). State exactly which control was possible.
- [ ] Positive 3: brute-force S_n enumeration (all n! orderings) agrees for all records at n<=7.
- [ ] Planted negative: a single flipped sign in W must change the column and must be caught by the validation harness (show the failing run).
- [ ] Benchmark: per-column time at n=11 on 1,000 random universe records, retained-hinge count distribution, extrapolated total nnz and wall time on 16 cores.
- No-claim: column generation only; nothing about MAX_11 membership.
## Deliverable
`tools/colgen/` + `artifacts/math/colgen-rust/RESULT.md` (commands, input hashes, counts, timings, what was not verified).

title: Exact rational witness recovery for n=9,10 + exact verifier + upstream translator
description:
## Context
No exact rational witness has been produced by our pipeline at any n; mod-p membership (n=5..10, handoff §3) is not a certificate. The n=11 decision needs an exact-Q lift and an exact full-row verifier, both tested on known answers first (handoff §8a step 1).
Saved systems: `handoff/2026-09-02-amberbluff/systems/loopless_system_n9.jsonl.gz` (10,976 cols, 6,326 hinge rows + 9 linear rows, rank 1,506 mod p) and `_n10.jsonl.gz` (12,248 cols, 16,709 + 10 rows, rank 2,166). Target: linear part = e_n (max coordinate on the sorted cone), all hinge rows = 0. Upstream certificates and verifier: `literature/repos/max-relu-certificates/` (certificate_9_4.json: 337 terms; certificate_10_4.json: 402 terms, lcm denominator 304,819,200; verify_certificate.py conventions in handoff §3).
## Outcome
`tools/exactlift/`: (1) given a sparse integer system consistent mod p, pick pivot columns from the mod-p echelon, solve the r×r system exactly (Dixon p-adic lifting + rational reconstruction, or fraction-free), output a small-support rational solution; (2) an exact verifier over Q: sum λ_c l_c = e_n and sum λ_c h_c = 0 on every direction in the union of supports; (3) a translator to the upstream certificate JSON format so the pinned upstream verifier can be run as an independent check.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Positive: exact rational witnesses for n=9 and n=10 from the saved systems, passing both our verifier and the upstream verifier; report support size, lcm denominator and its prime factorisation (Averkov–Hojny–Merkert Thm 2 forces 2 | denominator for n>=5 and 3 | denominator for n>=10; check).
- [ ] Known-answer: the upstream n=9 and n=10 certificates translated into our column basis PASS our verifier; the upstream n=10 certificate with one coefficient perturbed FAILS (planted negative, show the run).
- [ ] Planted negative 2: the n=9 subfamily with both sides spanning trees (beta=0) is reported INCONSISTENT (campaign G-0007: rank 360 vs 361); the pipeline must not manufacture a witness there.
- [ ] Timing: exact solve time at r=2,166; extrapolation to r≈30k–40k with memory estimate; say whether it fits in 60 GB and if not what the fallback is (e.g. multi-modular CRT with more primes).
- No-claim: nothing about n=11.
## Deliverable
`tools/exactlift/` + `artifacts/math/exact-witness-n9-n10/RESULT.md` + the two witness files with SHA-256.

title: Streaming sketched modular rank engine, validated on n=10 member and n=9 tree non-member
description:
## Context
The n=11 loopless system is ~754k columns × O(10^5–10^6) rows, ~5e9 nonzeros; a dense matrix is impossible (handoff §6 item 6). Plan: stream columns from tools/colgen through two independent sparse random row sketches (direction -> bucket via hash, random ±1 coefficients, m buckets each), maintain a dense echelon basis mod p (rank-sized, blocked reduction), report rank(SA), rank([SA|Sb]), saturation (rank vs m), throughput, peak RSS. Expected n=11 rank 25k–40k (ceiling 160k).
## Outcome
`tools/streamrank/` Rust engine, validated on known answers, with a written resource plan for the n=11 run (m, primes, cores, RAM, wall time).
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Positive: on n=10 (columns from tools/colgen or the saved Python system) with m >= 3×2,166, both sketches give rank 2,166 and MEMBER at primes 1,000,003 and 1,000,033, agreeing with the full dense rank.
- [ ] Planted negative: the n=9 beta=0 spanning-tree subfamily is NON-MEMBER (rank r vs r+1) under the sketch, as it is under full rank (G-0007).
- [ ] Sketch honesty: show a case where m is too small (m < rank) and the engine reports saturation rather than a verdict.
- [ ] Throughput: columns/s and entry-ops/s at n=10; projected n=11 wall time and RAM at m=96k and m=128k; a go/no-go for this 16-core/62 GB box vs a rented node.
- No-claim: mod-p sketched rank equality is neither exact consistency nor a certificate; the exact leg is tools/exactlift.
## Deliverable
`tools/streamrank/` + `artifacts/math/stream-rank-engine/RESULT.md`.

title: EXP-0036: decide MAX11 in the complete loopless k=5 universe + 5E/5L at two primes, exact lift or separator
description:
## Context
EXP-0036 (handoff §9 item 3): the decisive open experiment, gap G-0014. Subject: G-0027 universe (754,017 loopless signed-W orbits) + carriers 5E and 5L (G-0040). Rows: every primitive ambiguous direction touched by any column (d_0 = 0 automatically for loopless atoms) + the 11 linear coordinates. Primes 1,000,003 and 1,000,033. Sketch size from stream-rank-engine's plan with saturation check. Orchestrator writes the preregistration before the run starts; do not start before it exists in this bead's comments.
## Outcome
Either (A) MEMBER at both primes -> pivot support -> exact rational lift (tools/exactlift) -> exact verification on all rows -> upstream-format certificate -> hand to orchestrator for T2 referee; or (B) NON-MEMBER -> rational separator (left-kernel vector lifted to Q) verified exactly against every column (the honest null artifact) -> hand to orchestrator.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both primes agree on rank(SA), rank([SA|Sb]) and verdict; both sketches unsaturated.
- [ ] (A) exact witness passes tools/exactlift verifier and the upstream verifier; support size and denominators reported. (B) exact separator vanishes on every column and is nonzero on the target, verified over Q.
- [ ] Known-answer gates re-run in the same session: n=10 loop-free MEMBER, n=9 beta=0 NON-MEMBER.
- No-claim: (B) says nothing about MAX_11 in ReLU_2 (both construction papers and G-0084/G-0110 show the loopless k=5 family is not complete).
## Deliverable
`artifacts/math/n11-loopless-decision/RESULT.md` + witness or separator files with SHA-256.

title: Span structure n=5..10: exact kernels, local-move generation, vertex-collapse lemma, Burnside checks
description:
## Context
Path 4 of handoff §7: the loop-free column families are massively redundant (nullity 267/290/9,470/10,082 at n=7/8/9/10 vs ranks 90/140/1,506/2,166). Understanding the relations could collapse the n=11 solve from 754k columns to O(rank) generators and is the only route toward an all-n theorem. Saved systems: `handoff/2026-09-02-amberbluff/systems/*.jsonl.gz` (n=9,10); n<=8 regenerable in seconds with `handoff/2026-09-02-amberbluff/probes/loopless_probe_par.py`.
## Questions (answer each with computation or proof; a checked negative is a result)
1. Compute exact (over Q, not just mod p) right-kernel bases at n=7,8 (and n=9 if feasible). Are the relations generated by local moves on signed graphs (single edge swap, degree-preserving rewiring, common-edge cancellation)? Measure: dimension of the span of candidate local-move relations vs full nullity.
2. Vertex-collapse candidate lemma (unverified, from a Fable synthesis): "every loop-free n-template column equals the sum over the n labels v of the loop-inclusive (n-1)-template column obtained by placing v at the minimum". State it precisely in the sorted-cone convention, then prove it or give an explicit counterexample at n=6 or 7 (extend column_dp to loops = diagonal pairs (i,i)).
3. Verify or refute the Burnside counts 490,480 (n=12, k=5 loop-free simple pairs) and 18,436,223 (n=11, degree 6) using `handoff/2026-09-02-amberbluff/probes/count_simple_pairs.py` as the reference implementation.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each question has a RESULT section with exact commands, numbers with denominators, and PROVED / REFUTED (counterexample file) / OPEN (what was tried).
- [ ] Any proof is written out and machine-checked on n<=8 by explicit computation.
- No-claim: nothing here decides n=11 by itself.
## Deliverable
`artifacts/math/span-structure-n5-n10/RESULT.md` + scripts.

title: Refute track: verify or refute the Safran-derived 25-neuron 3-cover necessary condition
description:
## Context
Path 5 of handoff §7 (refute track, <=15% budget). A lower-bound reader derived, from Safran arXiv:2601.01417 (Prop A.4 and §2.4), that any two-hidden-layer ReLU representation of MAX_11 needs at least 25 first-layer neurons whose supports (size 2–3) form a 3-cover of all C(11,3)=165 triples. This is UNVERIFIED. Paper text: literature/papers/2601.01417*.txt.
## Task
Reconstruct the argument from the paper. Either prove the condition (state it exactly, with the argument written out) or show where the derivation fails. Planted positive: check that the n=5..10 upstream certificates (literature/repos/max-relu-certificates) satisfy the analogous condition at their n. If the condition holds it is a WALL (a necessary condition on any witness, usable as a hard constraint in witness search), never an impossibility result.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Written derivation with locators into the paper, verdict PROVED / REFUTED / OPEN.
- [ ] Certificate check script + table for n=5..10.
- No-claim: a necessary condition is not a lower bound on depth.
## Deliverable
`artifacts/math/refute-3cover/RESULT.md`.
